target_year_over_year_context.explanation:
Both disclosures concern the FASB November 2023 standard on significant expense disclosures in operating segments. D068 states the company is evaluating the impact before adoption, while D061 confirms adoption in FY2025. Evidence: D068 (nvda_2024_8_P066_S001, S002, S003), D061 (nvda_2025_8_P066_S001, S002).

The 2024 disclosure (D068) identifies a specific FASB standard issued in November 2023 requiring additional disclosures about significant expenses in operating segments, effective for FY2025. The 2025 disclosure (D063) identifies a different FASB standard issued in November 2024 requiring disclosures of specific expense components (inventory, compensation, depreciation, etc.), effective for FY2028. These are two distinct accounting standards with different issuance dates, subjects (operating segments vs. specific expense captions), and effective dates. They do not share the same specific subject.

comparisons.peer_topic: Adoption of ASU 2023-07 on Segment Reporting
comparisons.peer_summary: The Company adopted FASB ASU 2023-07 in the fourth quarter of 2024 to enhance disclosures about significant segment expenses, as this standard was effective for fiscal year 2024.
comparisons.comparison: Both NVIDIA and AMD disclose the adoption and impact of the same new FASB accounting standard (ASU 2023-07) regarding segment reporting and significant expense disclosures. The key difference is the timing of adoption within fiscal year 2024: AMD explicitly states it adopted the standard in the fourth quarter of 2024, whereas NVIDIA indicates it is 'currently evaluating the impact' of the standard which is effective for its fiscal year 2025 annual reporting, suggesting NVIDIA had not yet finalized the adoption or impact assessment as of its 2024 filing date compared to AMD's completed action.

sentences.text: In November 2023, the Financial Accounting Standards Board, or FASB, issued a new accounting standard to provide for additional disclosures about significant expenses in operating segments.
We are currently evaluating the impact of this standard on our Consolidated Financial Statements.

In November 2023, the Financial Accounting Standards Board (FASB) issued Accounting Standard Update (ASU) 2023-07 Segment Reporting (Topic 280) Improvements to Reportable Segment Disclosures to enhance disclosures about significant segment expenses.
The Company adopted this standard in the fourth quarter of 2024.
